theorems.name: Submission.adr_affine_invariant_closed_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsClosed S → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ‖y‖ ≤ 1 - lam → (fun x => y + lam • x) ⁻¹' S = S) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ z, y + lam • z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ S) ∧ (S.Nonempty → (L : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ S)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
